project_overview.project_summary: This business operations project centers on Troubleshoot and fix. The initial brief says: **GoHighLevel (GHL) Social Media Automation Optimization** I need an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) specialist to troubleshoot, fix, and optimize my social media automation funnel. My goal is for GHL to function similarly to ManyChat for automating engagement and lead capture. The work sits mainly in Marketing automation, Data Science & Analytics, AI & Machine Learning. Stable project themes include social engagement automation, keyword-triggered replies, lead capture and workflow routing, end-to-end automation testing. The available evidence includes 25 conversation messages, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. For onboarding, the key task is to understand the intended audience, source assets, production workflow, review loop, delivery formats, and constraints that determine acceptance. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
